fee_notes: Base fee is $49,500 for a single territory Core Program franchise. Veterans and/or educators receive a $4,950 discount (reduced fee of $44,550). An additional $7,500 per Plus Program is charged if additional programming is elected. Multi-territory purchases reduce the per-territory fee: 2 territories = $44,500 each ($94,000 cumulative), 3 = $40,000 each ($134,000), 4 = $35,000 each ($169,000), 5 = $30,000 each ($199,000). A Territory Overage Fee of $0.13 per person applies if territory population exceeds 400,000. An Enhanced Business Coaching and Training Fee of $5,750 is required for first-time franchisees. The fee is paid at signing and is generally non-refundable, except 50% is refunded if the franchisee fails to complete training.
raw_excerpt:
Your initial franchise fee will be $49,500 for a Franchised Business offering the Core Program. If you elect to offer additional programming, you agree to pay an additional fee of $7,500 per program (the " Plus Program Fee"), which includes the cost of equipment and additional training in connection with offering that Plus Program.

If you are an honorably discharged veteran and/or educator, we will reduce the initial franchise fee by $4,950 for the Core Program.

Total Territories Purchased | Initial Franchise Fee | Cumulative Fee
1 | $49,500 | $49,500
2 | $44,500 | $94,000
3 | $40,000 | $134,000
4 | $35,000 | $169,000
5 | $30,000 | $199,000
